decision_conditions: <p><span style="line-height:normal"><span style="font-size:11.0pt"><span calibri="">The proposed c</span></span><span style="font-size:11.0pt"><span calibri=""><span style="color:#333333">hange of use from single dwellinghouse (C3) to HMO for 8 people (Sui Generis<em>)</em></span></span></span><span style="font-size:11.0pt"><span calibri=""> by reason of insufficient information submitted to show the location and provision of cycle parking, details of how&nbsp;waste would be stored and managed&nbsp;on the site together with the lack of soft landscaping to enhance the development, would result in a substandard form of development for the future occupies of the site and could give rise to a visual clutter of the forecourt to the detriment of the character and appearance of the streetscene.&nbsp;The proposal would therefore conflict with the aspirations of Policies&nbsp;T5, T6.1 and D3&nbsp;of The London Plan 2021 and Policies&nbsp;GR1, HO10, M1 and M2 of Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041).</span></span></span></p>

<span style="line-height:normal"><span style="font-size:11.0pt"><span calibri="">The proposed c</span></span><span style="font-size:11.0pt"><span calibri=""><span style="color:#333333">hange of use from single dwellinghouse (C3) to HMO for 8 people (Sui Generis)<em> </em></span></span></span><span style="font-size:11.0pt"><span calibri="">by reason of an over intensification of use of the property into an 8 person HMO is unacceptable in principle due to the site’s poor accessibility to public transport, site’s suitability, insufficient internal floorspace, cumulative impact to the prevailing residential character of the area and the excessive number of occupants would give rise to a development that would be&nbsp;detrimental to the residential character of the&nbsp;area and the amenities of neighbouring residents. The proposal would therefore be contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies&nbsp;D3 and D14&nbsp;of The&nbsp;London Plan 2021 and Policies&nbsp;GR1 and HO10 of Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041).&nbsp;</span></span></span>
description: Change of use from Single dwelling (C3) to HMO for 8 people (Sui Generis)
